title: Solo Testers Scored 99% Right, Yet 75% Lied When 5 Strangers Disagreed
description:
Matching two black lines is so easy that solo testers score ninety-nine percent! Yet five calm strangers made grown students deny their own eyes! This is the true story of Solomon Asch's Conformity Experiment. Here is what went wrong at Swarthmore College in nineteen fifty-one.
